1.Nf3 Nf6 2.b3 d5 3.Bb2 c5 4.e4.strategy: A pawn offer in the centre: both ...dxe4 and ...Nxe4 win it, because nothing defends it. White hopes that the bishop's diagonal, which opens towards g7 if the f6-knight takes, and quick play against Black's centre will pay for it, but White has to justify the pawn.
1.Nf3 Nf6 2.b3 d5 3.Bb2 c5 4.e4.name: Nimzowitsch–Larsen Attack: Norfolk Gambit
